_note: Two halves, one serving-path change-set in runtime/service/tools.py and the recall scoring path. (A) LENS COVERAGE: wire `lens` (default 'dev', validated against structure.lenses.lens_names()) into the 5 handlers listed in the round baseline's lens_param_present._absent (learning_search, list_pages, search, session_bootstrap, think) and thread the value so each surface's RESULT SET is filtered by the lens map — reuse lenses.lens_admits_fm / the recall_v7 rank_claims pattern, never a parallel reimplementation. The counter tracks wiring only (RFC 0009 §5.5 names it for its limit), so the behavioural gate is a required deliverable of this goal, not optional test hygiene: on a seeded corpus, at least one newly-wired surface called under lens='dev' vs lens='full' must return DIFFERING result sets (dev excludes personal, full includes), in the shape of verify._check_dev_lens_no_personal; plus a dev-session project-scoping test asserting foreign operational claims are absent/deprioritized. metrics.lens_param_present.unimplemented is a numeric non-underscore leaf, IS in the envelope namespace, and stays default-denied at 0 — a wired-but-unimplementable surface cannot hide there. (B) CROSS-PROJECT NOISE: the dev-session claim path for this repo's session returns 73 claims of which 51 are foreign (foreign_ratio 0.6986, own 14, unowned 8). The fix is project-awareness in the SERVING path (e.g. strengthen/gate the project prior in recall_v7.score_claim, or scope operational claims to the session project in the dev lens path) — never a vault edit, never a fixture edit, never special-casing the fixture's probe queries (the fixture is content-pinned by pins.fixture_sha256 and its path recorded in fixture_path for the verifier's --fixture). The ratio is dilution-prone, so the contract binds the absolutes too: foreign <= 10 (sharply down from 51), own >= 14 (not below its round-baseline value), returned >= 20 (the §5.4 minimum-yield floor stated as INTENT so an under-delivering lens FAILs on a named clause), unowned <= 12 (near the round value 8 plus small headroom, so unattributed claims cannot become the dilution channel). If a round under-delivers (returned < 20) the counter omits foreign_ratio and the composition leaves while returned stays — per §5.4's outcome table that lands as a fixer-addressable FAIL, not an abort. ENVELOPE: default-deny with NO waiver on vault.content_fingerprint — the vault is not touched, so census/surfacing/fingerprint must be byte-identical; in particular surfacing.visible is held at exact equality (179), strictly stronger than its forbids-fall invariant, which forces the project prior to be session-scoped rather than a global reranking that darkens foreign claims' own-concept surfacing. The five eval waivers exist because eval probes run through the same retrieval pipeline the goal reranks: the two recall_at_k leaves have live invariant backstops and floor at the exact round-baseline values; the three un-gated leaves (both mrr, self_probe.dark_count) are pinned at their exact round-baseline values (full float precision) so no sub-baseline headroom exists — floors/caps, not equality, so improvement remains legal. supersedes is empty: nothing here may fall or rise against an invariant clause; the eval-engine guard (§6 hybrid canary) raises on any engine mismatch between snapshots so these comparisons cannot be phantoms of a degraded provider. Pins: before_sha256 over the round baseline at ~/.atelier/cache/goals/G3-lens-coverage/before.json; captured_at_head is the pre-contract main HEAD and must be this contract commit's first parent; fixture_sha256 over the out-of-tree probe fixture (counts-and-shape pin, §5.6 — the contract itself carries no vault strings or adopter project names).
